versions.changelog: Fix markdown formatting — broken code blocks and blockquote lint
Fix: declare required env vars (DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY) in SKILL.md metadata, add homepage link

Initial release of Datadog MCP server skill.

- Query Datadog logs, traces, metrics, monitors, incidents, dashboards, hosts, synthetics, and workflows via MCP.
- Supports both remote (Streamable HTTP) and local (stdio) MCP transports.
- Toolsets can be selected via URL parameters for fine-grained access.
- Detailed setup instructions for remote, local, and CLI usage included.
- Requires DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY; optionally supports multi-site configuration with DD_SITE.
- Security best practices and operational runbooks referenced.
